training_reward: All supplied Python test-program checks pass, binary reward. Source tests are not independently certified.
development_protocol: Existing original + expanded MBPP checks, unchanged.
limitations: Supplied tests may be weak or wrong. Passing them is not proof of correctness.
Statement matching removes exact/near-identical text, not every semantic duplicate or pretraining overlap.
Only plain Python test programs with explicit assert/raise checks are supported; pytest/unittest discovery is not integrated.
